title: Dispensing Diluted Phage to Agar Plates
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Define run parameters
steps.instruction: Specify the number of agar plates (1‑5), the number of columns per plate (1‑12), the number of rows per plate (1‑8), and which mount (left or right) will hold the P20 multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Load tips for rows
steps.instruction: Attach a P20 multi‑channel tip strip containing one tip for each row specified (1‑8 tips) on the chosen mount.

steps.title: Aspirate diluted phage
steps.instruction: Using the P20, aspirate 2.5 µL × (number of plates) of diluted phage from column 1 of the 360 µL Corning source plate.

steps.title: Dispense into column 1
steps.instruction: Dispense the aspirated volume into column 1 of each agar plate (up to the specified number of plates) by positioning the tips just above the agar surface so they do not touch the medium, thereby saving tip usage.

steps.title: Repeat for remaining columns
steps.instruction: For each subsequent column (2 through the specified number of columns), repeat the aspirate‑and‑dispense cycle without changing tips, reusing the same tip strip (up to five times) to save tip consumption.
